description: This file implements the StateHandler class for managing lifecycle states in a plugin framework, including state transitions, validation, and event notifications.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing lifecycle state transitions, validation, and event notifications within the plugin framework.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application context to a new lifecycle state, handling state creation and transition logic.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object based on the specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition from one lifecycle state to another is valid based on predefined rules.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the possible state transitions and state string mappings.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Performs a state transition request, validating the transition, updating states, and emitting events.
